BiblicalUsage: To cover is the word for the skin coming back on the dry bones: I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and when Ezekiel looked, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the covering as the sign that the bones were becoming a body again, and the body was waiting for the breath.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
